reports.title: Narcotics Seizure – Dharavi, Mumbai
reports.text: On 12 November 2024, officers from the Mumbai Anti-Narcotics Cell arrested Arjun Mehta and his associate Suresh Pillai near the Dharavi market complex. A vehicle bearing registration MH-02-AB-1234 was found carrying 4 kg of heroin. Arjun Mehta was in possession of a mobile phone with number 9820045678. Suresh Pillai's known associate Kabir Ansari, affiliated with the Red Crescent Syndicate, was last seen in Dharavi on 10 November. Suresh Pillai's contact number was noted as 9867123456.

reports.title: Arms Cache Discovery – Patna, Bihar
reports.text: On 18 November 2024, Bihar STF recovered an arms cache in the Phulwari Sharif locality of Patna. Informer tipoff led to the arrest of Devraj Singh and Manoj Tiwari. A motorcycle with registration BR-01-CD-5678 was seized at the scene. Devraj Singh admitted receiving instructions from an individual known only as 'Chacha', believed to be operating from Patna. Manoj Tiwari was found with a SIM card linked to number 9334567890. A receipt found in the vehicle bore the name Red Crescent Syndicate.

reports.title: Hawala Transaction Intercept – Delhi
reports.text: Delhi Police's Economic Offences Wing intercepted a hawala transaction of ₹2.3 crore linked to Rajan Verma operating from Chandni Chowk, Delhi. Rajan Verma was seen coordinating with an associate named Priya Sharma at a tea stall. The vehicle used for cash transport bore the registration DL-05-EF-9012. Rajan Verma's contact number 9711234567 was identified from call records. Priya Sharma was observed meeting Kabir Ansari near Connaught Place two weeks earlier.

reports.title: Cyber Fraud Ring – Jamtara, Jharkhand
reports.text: Jharkhand Police dismantled a cyber fraud operation in Jamtara, arresting five individuals including Rohit Kumar and Anita Jha. The group used mobile numbers 9801234567 and 9334567890 to conduct vishing attacks targeting senior citizens. A laptop seized from Rohit Kumar contained records of transactions routed through shell entities including TechVault Solutions. Anita Jha was found with vehicle registration JH-10-GH-3456. Authorities note that the number 9334567890 appears in earlier Patna records.

reports.title: Human Trafficking Network – Agra, UP
reports.text: UP STF busted a human trafficking ring operating from Agra to Delhi. Key suspects include Farida Shaikh and Govind Rao. A minibus with registration UP-80-IJ-7890 was used to transport victims. Farida Shaikh communicated via number 9456789012. Govind Rao was linked through call records to Rajan Verma (contact 9711234567), establishing a potential financial connection between the trafficking ring and the Delhi hawala network. Victims reported being held near Taj Ganj, Agra.

reports.title: Explosive Material Cache – Hyderabad
reports.text: Hyderabad Police's bomb disposal unit found 12 kg of RDX hidden in a warehouse in Secunderabad. Surveillance linked the warehouse to Imran Qureshi and his brother Salim Qureshi. Vehicle TS-09-KL-2345 was seen near the warehouse multiple times. Imran Qureshi's phone 9440098765 showed calls to an unknown number in Delhi. The Secunderabad warehouse was rented under the name of a shell company called BlueShield Logistics.

reports.title: Drug Courier Network – Chennai Port
reports.text: Chennai Customs intercepted a drug shipment at Chennai Port concealed in a spice consignment. Suspects include Selvam Krishnan and Meena Rajan. A vehicle TN-09-MN-6789 was used to transport the consignment to a warehouse in Koyambedu. Selvam Krishnan's contact number 9444056789 was traced. Intelligence suggests Selvam Krishnan had prior contact with Arjun Mehta from Mumbai indicating a cross-regional network. Meena Rajan communicated with an entity called SunriseExport Pvt Ltd.

reports.title: Land Grab Nexus – Bengaluru
reports.text: Karnataka CID initiated an investigation into fraudulent land registrations in Whitefield, Bengaluru. Central figures are Deepa Nair and her associate Vivek Shetty. Forged documents were transported in vehicle KA-03-OP-4567. Deepa Nair's contact number 9845067890 appeared on documents. A company named PrimeLand Ventures was used as a front. Vivek Shetty was found to share an office with Priya Sharma who is already known to Delhi Police from Case RPT-003.

reports.title: Counterfeit Currency – Kolkata
reports.text: West Bengal Police seized fake currency notes worth ₹50 lakh from a printing press in Metiabruz, Kolkata. Arrested suspects: Habibur Rahman and Nasreen Bibi. Vehicle WB-06-QR-8901 was used for distribution. Habibur Rahman's phone 9831067890 was in contact with a number in Nepal. Nasreen Bibi was found to have a prior acquaintance with Devraj Singh from the Patna arms case (RPT-002). The operation was funded through Red Crescent Syndicate accounts, tying it back to RPT-001 and RPT-002.

reports.title: HIDDEN LINK: Shadow Coordinator – Rajan Verma
reports.text: An intelligence note from RAW indicates that Rajan Verma (phone 9711234567), previously identified in the Delhi hawala case (RPT-003), made three calls to Imran Qureshi (phone 9440098765) of the Hyderabad explosives case (RPT-006) in the week preceding the Secunderabad warehouse discovery. This establishes Rajan Verma as a potential shadow coordinator across at least four cases: RPT-003 (Hawala/Delhi), RPT-005 (Trafficking/Agra), RPT-006 (Explosives/Hyderabad), and RPT-007 (Drugs/Chennai) via Arjun Mehta's connection. Rajan Verma may be connected to BlueShield Logistics and PrimeLand Ventures as financial beneficiaries. Recommended for immediate surveillance.

brief.title: INVESTIGATOR CASE BRIEF — CrimeNet Analysis
brief.summary: Analysis of 10 intelligence reports revealed a network of 87 entities connected by 534 relationships. The network spans multiple jurisdictions including Mumbai, Delhi, Patna, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bengaluru, and Kolkata.
